# --instructions--

Write a function `invert(map: Map<String, Int>): Map<Int, String>` that returns a new map where every value of `map` becomes a key and every key becomes its value. Assume all values in `map` are distinct.

Example of function call:
```kotlin
println(invert(mapOf("one" to 1, "two" to 2)))
// prints {1=one, 2=two}
```

# --asserts--

`invert(mapOf("one" to 1, "two" to 2))` must return `{1=one, 2=two}`

```kotlin
    tryCatch(invert(mapOf("one" to 1, "two" to 2)) == mapOf(1 to "one", 2 to "two"))
```

`invert(mapOf("x" to 10))` must return `{10=x}`

```kotlin
    tryCatch(invert(mapOf("x" to 10)) == mapOf(10 to "x"))
```

`invert` of an empty map must return an empty map

```kotlin
    tryCatch(invert(mapOf<String, Int>()) == mapOf<Int, String>())
```

# --solutions--

```kotlin
fun invert(map: Map<String, Int>): Map<Int, String> {
    val result = mutableMapOf<Int, String>()
    for ((key, value) in map) {
        result[value] = key
    }
    return result
}
```
